summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（To this end, this technical report details the first release of OLMo, a state-of-the-art, truly Open Language Model and its framework to build and study the science of language modeling）。

summaries.title: Efficient Exploration for LLMs
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Efficient Exploration for LLMs** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）。核心论点主张：We present evidence of substantial benefit from efficient exploration in gathering human feedback to improve large language models。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Our best-performing agent generates queries using double Thompson sampling, with uncertainty represented by an epistemic neural network。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our results demonstrate that efficient exploration enables high levels of performance with far fewer queries）。
